The fix must not over-tighten: its failure conditions include \"an accurate supported answer is forced to meet all optional criteria\" (line 197), and \"Contract required_for_pass sign-off remains the separate .51 merge gate\" (line 199).", "general": true, "duplicate_of": "", "name_bearing_source": false, "found_by": "A retelling that reversed the story's events was accepted at a 2-of-3 bar because two language criteria (a connective and a taught word) outvoted the factual one. Once the factual criterion was required, the real contradiction was rejected and a corrected answer passed.", "scope_note": "universal for open answers marked by counting criteria; found on Grade 3 retell and recount items", "adds_to_existing": [272]}

{"index": 2, "verdict": "keep", "reason": "Quotes verbatim at 72, 72 and 84. The cause rests on an exact-request replay through the real route (an invented criterion ID despite a positive judgment). The fix (exact IDs, complete unique booleans) was followed by native acceptance of the unchanged answer. 'Duplicated' is backed by line 197's held case for duplicated conflicting verdicts, which I added. 'Neither passes nor fails' is backed by line 84 (not learner-wrong) and line 197 (cannot pass). Related to 682 (unsure is neither pass nor miss), but the trigger and the validation step are new.", "statement": "Check a model marker's reply against the exact criteria it was sent, and treat a missing, invented or duplicated criterion verdict as a marking failure that neither passes nor fails the learner.", "kind": "measured", "evidence": [{"path": "~/Projects/grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json", "lines": "72", "quote": "The current grading path rejected the exact authored supported answer.", "verbatim": true}, {"path": "~/Projects/grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json", "lines": "72", "quote": "The isolated exact-request production-route diagnostic reproduces the cause with invented criterion ID despite a positive semantic judgment", "verbatim": true}, {"path": "~/Projects/grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json", "lines": "84", "quote": "Technical cause fixed in 801a01a5: exact authored criterion IDs and complete/unique boolean validation prevent malformed model output from becoming learner-wrong; valid false and Grade3 rules preserved.", "verbatim": true}, {"path": "~/Projects/grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json", "lines": "197", "quote": "Factual criterion missing, duplicated with conflicting verdicts, or malformed is held.", "verbatim": true}], "against": "The live failure's raw reply was lost, so the cause rests on a reproduction: \"Its internal cause is not yet isolated because the original HTTP/model response was not captured.\" (BEAD-REGISTER.json line 72)", "general": true, "duplicate_of": "", "name_bearing_source": false, "found_by": "The marker rejected the course's own supported answer, byte-identical to its reveal. Replaying the exact request through the real route showed a positive judgment returned under an invented criterion ID, which the route counted as a miss. After exact-ID and complete, unique boolean validation, the unchanged answer was accepted. The recount repair applied the same rule from the other side: a missing or malformed verdict on a required criterion cannot pass.", "scope_note": "universal for model-marked answers", "adds_to_existing": [682]}
